summary.text: John McBride is the Republican nominee for California's 9th Congressional District. A longtime strength and conditioning coach in the Stockton area, his campaign focuses on reducing government spending, border security and support for law enforcement.

paragraphs.text: McBride was born in Meriden, Connecticut, and, according to his campaign website, is originally from Connecticut; he earned a bachelor's degree from Central Connecticut State University in 1984.
He moved to California in 1989 to become the first strength and conditioning coach at the University of the Pacific, where he served athletes for 12 years, according to the website.
He then served as the first strength coach at St. Mary's High School in Stockton for 13 years and says he has worked more than 40 years as a strength coach.
McBride says he served on the founding board of the Stockton Leadership Foundation and on the boards of Christian Community Concerns and the Stockton Pregnancy Help Center.
He says he has been married to his wife Nicole since 1994 and that they have five children.
He advanced from the June 2026 top-two primary in second place with 23.3% of the vote and says on his campaign website that he is not a politician.
